findings.issue: «contarán» locks qal H6485 to counting. The frame על + absolute במשמרת + את leaves appoint/assign, number, visit, and muster open.
«a» before the inanimate load can be read as the preposition to/toward, like the earlier lamed. את is only the object marker, and משמרת is absolute, so the load is the object of the verb.

notes: Mouth, singular gentilic, 3fs será, repeated carga/servicio, and 2mp as ustedes stay inside the tokens.
